firm_data.firm_description: Wertheimer Fredman, LLC is a boutique law firm with a focus on real estate, estate planning and administration, trusts and business law.
notable_facts: The firm has offices in White Plains and New York City.
Michele Fredman has been with the firm since 1979.

email.subject: AI for Wertheimer Fredman, built for boutique real estate and estate planning
email.body:
Hi Michele,

With offices across White Plains and New York City, Wertheimer Fredman handles the kind of complex real estate and estate planning work that demands precision and trust. Managing that scope with a lean team means every efficiency counts.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your White Plains office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
